description: Machine-readable evidence ledger linking all 30 standalone refutation, vacuity-probe, statement-strength, twin-equivalence, and regression-guard Lean files under docs/audits/ to the library declarations, Lean modules, and folio/quantum-observable-universe/ content blocks they concern (LEANNODES L5). Uncontended target blocks also carry back-links in their .ts manifest authorNotes (`see: "docs/audits/..."`).

entries.summary: Demonstrates that three carriers typed with bare `Prop` fields (`DimMasterPentagon`, `BringSurfaceSmoothness`, `HabiroFlowSolution`) are trivially inhabited by `True` / `trivial`, rendering downstream `[C]`-conditional theorems unconditional until fields are typed by concrete propositions.

Imports live library modules `QOU.Habiro.FlowSolution` and `QOU.Mathlib.HeckeAlgebra`: exhibits trivial inhabitation of `QOU.Habiro.HabiroFlowSolution` (part 1, live) and serves as regression guard (`zero_generators_rejected`) confirming `IwahoriHeckeAlgebra`'s Hecke/braid/far-commute fields now reject zero generators (part 2, closed 2026-09-07).

Regression guard on `QOU.Mathlib.HeckeAlgebra` verifying that `triv_hecke` and `triv_wedderburn` remain explicit `def`s rather than global `instance`s over `PUnit`, so `[IwahoriHeckeAlgebra R n q]` hypotheses are never silently discharged.

Exhibits zero-witness inhabitations (`aubin`, `ns`, `crit`, `blowup`, `breakdown`) for the five pre-repair local `Prop` classes in `fluid-dynamics/core-levi-form.lean` (`∃ K ≥ 0, K ≤ 2E`, `(3*4 : ℕ) = 12`, etc.).

Records two independent proofs of `False` against the former unguarded axioms in `QOU.Mathlib.ParallelogramContour` (missing `Differentiable ℂ f` and missing positive orientation `0 < (ω₂ / ω₁).im` at `ω₁ = ω₂ = 0`), and verifies the repaired theorems remain usable.

Probes `QOU.Interactions.QIntegerMassFormula`: shows a global `canonical` instance sets `f_magic = fun _ => 0` and `tolerance = 1 / 100`, and that `fits_AME_conditional` projects `IsAMEValue.fits_bound` directly without constraining `B` to measured AME entries.

Constructs explicit hand witnesses (`1` or constant functions) inhabiting six self-contained `Prop` carriers left undecided by the zero-only prober (`QAubinLions`, `RegularityBreakdown`, `PvsNPQou`, `ClassicalLimitStpart`, `CrystalGraphRealization`, `QIntegerMassFormula`), and confirms the seventh (`SeparateLambdaScale_Antipattern`) is deliberately uninhabitable (`is_antipattern : False`).

Machine-generated sweep (`scripts/vacuous-prop-carrier-probe.py`) testing 23 `Prop` carriers (`Cand0..Cand22`) across fluid dynamics, `ConditionalClasses`, `PvsNPQou`, `MarkovTraceOnHecke`, `FMapStructuralPaths`, mass theory, and `geom-universality` for zero-witness inhabitability.

Shows the pre-2026-08-29 `CriticalExponent` and `NSCounterexample` carriers admitted regular counter-witnesses (`enstrophy q = max q 0` bounded near `q = 1`, `velocityProfile t x = max (-t) 0` vanishing near `T* = 1`), and proves both witnesses are excluded by the punctured-neighbourhood repair.

Proves `old_bound_shape_is_refutable` showing the pre-2026-08-29 `HasQPlancherelCLT` field (quantifying universally over arbitrary `f : ℕ → ℝ` and `f_inf : ℝ` after fixing `Cq`) was uninhabitable, and exhibits an inhabitant of the repaired existential shape.

Proves `quantified_index_forces_zero`: universally quantifying `partitions_of_r : Finset P` in `QOU.Archimedean.rj_canonical_inner_product` forced `jonesPoly r s = 0` upon instantiating at `∅`; verifies carrying `partitionsOf` as structure data admits non-vanishing models.

Imports `QOU.AlgebraicSubstrate.ConditionalClasses` and documents the complete closure of all five q-NS carriers (`QAubinLions`, `NSCounterexample`, `CriticalExponent`, `RegularityBreakdown`, and the replacement of `BlowupYekutieli` by the obstruction-vanishing criterion of `prop:blowup-yekutieli`).

Proves the pre-2026-08-30 theorems in `QOU.AlgebraicSubstrate.ConditionalCorollaries` (`reeb_period_bound`, `enstrophy_cube_bound`, `rogue_zero_cost`, `critical_exponent_identity`) with all `[QAubinLions]`-family binders deleted, exposing unused hypothesis binders and `(3 * 4 : ℕ) = 12`.

First gate of bean `qou-z9ws`: inhabits `SixTermMassFormulaContext`, `JetPrefixGbFiltrationContext`, `ReidemeisterMassInvarianceContext` (since retired), `RMatrixBraidingContext` (since retired; commutative witness retained), and `KnotFactorSpectralContext` with `Unit`/zero/one models, and proves `Term7ShellCorrectionClass` asserts only the literal sign `-1 < 0` (`alpha5_value := -1`).

Per-class hand adjudication across 33 `QOU.*` modules: constructs hypothesis-free witnesses for unparameterised context classes (`EwInterfaceKnotContext`, `AtomicLPStabilityContext`, `ZHabiroConvergenceClass`, `SpectralSequenceH3ExplicitContext`, `Terms26HigherOperationsContext`, `SortingColorEnergyContext`, `DecayChannelContext`, `ConfinementFrobeniusReciprocityContext`, `EInfinityIdentificationsContext`, `MarkovTraceContext`/`QmnRecursiveMemoizedContext`/`ToffoliTransferMatrixContext`, `NobleGasMultiOperator`, `LevelSufficient`, `ShellClosureMonotone` via trivial `LE R_q`, `LpDualStabilityContext`, `ParityRegimeSelectionContext`, `FourTermPairNucleonContext`, `SkeinMassFromLinkingContext`) while certifying `MatrixChainEqBuildChains`, `HasFiniteLPDuality`, `ConvergenceBound`, and `QIntRatioBoundSmall` as non-vacuous.

Adjudicates four formalize-first gate classes (`MassAnchorStableGateClass`, `MassDirectionSanityGateClass`, `DirectionSanityGateClass`, `BarEvenKernel`): confirms all four are refutable (not vacuous), but proves the additive `10 * target` band on both direction-sanity gates admits `0` and every `m ∈ [0, 1]` (`admits_everything_below_one`).

Proves concrete parameter refutations for all five re-encoded q-NS carriers in `QOU.AlgebraicSubstrate.ConditionalClasses` (`¬ QAubinLions 0`, `¬ NSCounterexample 0`, `¬ RegularityBreakdown (Ioo 0 1)`, `¬ CriticalExponent e (-1)`, `¬ CriticalExponent 0 α`, `¬ BlowupYekutieli 0 False`) plus non-trivial satisfiability witnesses for four.

Proves (`skein_pnd_identity_false_guard`) that the exact proton/neutron/deuteron skein equality `q · m_p − q⁻¹ · m_n = (√q − 1/√q) · m_d` formerly asserted by `QOU.HadronicMass.SkeinMassRelationHolds` is false by 0.41% (`194.5164` vs `195.3202`), guarding removal of the false hypothesis class.

Refutes the former `DoubleMagicConjecture.magic_iff_double_magic` field in `QOU.Interactions.LRFusion` (both at `emptyComposite` where `0 ∉ magicLadder` and across all `7 × 7` magic pairs where only `8 + 20 = 28` has a magic sum, excluding ⁴He, ¹⁶O, ⁴⁰Ca, ⁵⁶Ni, ²⁰⁸Pb), and guards the saturation fix `emptyComposite_not_isDoubleMagic`.

Certifies `QOU.Molecular.H2SAngleS3HolonomyConjecture` as parametric and refutable (`¬ ... ⟨1, 0⟩`) while noting `d : H2SChiralData` is unpinned to the geometric angle/holonomy; and shows `RadiusOfConvergenceGateClass` (`q-beta-radius-of-convergence-gate.lean`) is inert because `axiom qBetaCandidatePoleLocation : ℝ` is an unconstrained global constant.

Replicates all ten `class BorromeanQuark` declarations across the corpus (`T1..T10`) and constructs hypothesis-free trivial instances for every one, showing `[BorromeanQuark]` binders over unparameterised data fields do not constrain external objects.

Round-two conjecture-carrier audit (`C1..C5`): exhibits trivial instances for `CrystalGraphRealization` (`PUnit` with `raising = none`, and `0` in `transfer-matrix-level-independence`), `CanonicalMarkovWeightsH3` (`y3 = 1, y21 = y111 = 0`), and `wigner-coefficient-derivation`'s `QIntegerMassFormula`; and proves `C5.not_inhabited : ¬ Nonempty QIntegerMassFormula` for the unrestricted `∀ B_AME : ℝ` copy in `mass-theory/q-integer-mass-formula.lean`.

Applies the replicate-and-inhabit test (`qou-7yj0`) to two §3b-cond item-5 violations: inhabits `GBResidueSpectralSum` (`levelBound = 0`, `mass = 0`) and `MarkovTraceRecursiveReducerContext` (`Braid = Unit`, `reduce = id`), and uses parametric `BrunnianDecoupling` (`¬ BrunnianDecoupling 2 3 5`) as the negative control.

Proves `arch_is_generic_at_R` showing the library's `ℝ`-valued `speedOfLight` (`1 / (q - 1)`) equals the generic unit-typed sibling `speedOfLightGeneric` wherever `q - 1` is invertible, and `arch_is_junk_at_one` showing the library version silently returns `0` at `q = 1` where `speedOfLight` is documented to diverge.

Proves across five generic-sibling vs `ℝ`-library twin pairs (`operationalEntropy`, `informationBandwidth`, `gravitationalConstant`/`cellEntropy`, `qReebVectorField`, `IsAlgebraicallyPrime`) that each archimedean definition is an instantiation of its generic sibling, while identifying division-by-zero junk points where unit hypotheses were dropped (`q = 0`, `q = 1`, and `q = 1/2` in `cellEntropyArch`).

Imports `QOU.BraidKnot.MarkovAxiomsPrimitive` and proves `probe_no_instance_needed` and `probe_holds_for_any_function`: the existential conclusion `∀ τ_x, ∃ τ_x_stab, τ_x_stab = τ_x * markovZax u` of `MarkovTraceAxioms_implies_disjoint_stabilisation` holds by `rfl` without using `[MarkovTraceAxioms u]`.

Imports `QOU.BraidKnot.MarkovAxiomsPrimitive` and proves `probe_trivially_inhabited`: `MarkovTraceAxioms u` is inhabited for any field element `u` by `⟨1, rfl, markovZax u, rfl⟩`, making downstream theorems such as `disjoint_product_factorisation` unconditional.

Refines `2026-09-05-archimedean-twins-are-instantiations-probe.lean`: proves that `field_ge_one : 1 ≤ field p` on `QOU.ArchimedeanSubstrateField` (`SubstrateParameter.lean`) makes `q = 0` (`operationalEntropy`) and `q = 1/2` (`gravitationalConstant`/`S_cell`) unreachable, while `q = 1` IS reachable (`classicalSubstrate`) so `speedOfLight` and `informationBandwidth` returning `0` at `q = 1` remain live boundary defects.

Abstract companion to `2026-08-23-free-prop-field-triviality-probe.lean` and `QOU.ProofHygiene.SelfAssumingContexts`: proves `Nonempty PropUniverseContext ∧ ¬ Nonempty (PropFieldContext False)` and shows adding an `all_hold : p ∧ q` conjunction over `Prop`-typed fields (`PropUniverseWithConjunction`, as in `HabiroFlowSolution`) remains trivially inhabited.

Machine-checked refutation (`axiom_is_false : False`) of the former `eigenvalue_norm_sq_axiom` in `q-geometric-langlands/hasse-weil-bound.lean`: omitting `eigenvalues_ne_zero` allowed the all-zeros Frobenius eigenvalue witness to satisfy `(q : ℂ) / 0 = 0` and derive `0 = q` against `0 < q` (since repaired by adding `eigenvalues_ne_zero` and discharging the axiom).
